<mujoco model="conn_free2">
  <option timestep="0.002"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="a" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1"/>
      <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.02" mass="1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="b" pos="0.35 0 1">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="box" size="0.05 0.04 0.03" mass="2" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <equality>
    <connect body1="a" body2="b" anchor="0.3 0 0"/>
  </equality>
</mujoco>

cable.xml:
<mujoco model="cable-connect-stability">
  <compiler angle="radian"/>

  <option timestep="0.001" tolerance="1e-12" integrator="implicitfast" iterations="200"/>


  <worldbody>
    <body name="left" pos="-0.5 0 1">
      <body name="AB_first">
        <geom name="AG0" size="0.01 0.166667" pos="0.166667 0 0" quat="0.707107 0 -0.707107 0" type="capsule" contype="0" conaffinity="0" density="200"/>
        <site name="AS_first" pos="0 0 0" group="3"/>
        <body name="AB_1" pos="0.333333 0 0">
          <joint name="AJ_1" pos="0 0 0" type="ball" group="3" damping="0.5"/>
          <geom name="AG1" size="0.01 0.166667" pos="0.166667 0 0" quat="0.707107 0 -0.707107 0" type="capsule" contype="0" conaffinity="0" density="200"/>
          <body name="AB_last" pos="0.333333 0 0">
            <joint name="AJ_last" pos="0 0 0" type="ball" group="3" damping="0.5"/>
            <geom name="AG2" size="0.01 0.166667" pos="0.166667 0 0" quat="0.707107 0 -0.707107 0" type="capsule" contype="0" conaffinity="0" density="200"/>
            <site name="AS_last" pos="0.333333 0 0" group="3"/>
          </body>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
    <body name="right" pos="0.5 0 1">
      <geom size="0.01" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <contact>
    <exclude body1="AB_first" body2="AB_1"/>
    <exclude body1="AB_1" body2="AB_last"/>
  </contact>

  <equality>
    <connect body1="AB_last" body2="right" anchor="0.33333 0 0" solref="0.002 1"/>
  </equality>
</mujoco>

limit_margin.xml:
<mujoco model="limit_margin">
  <compiler angle="radian"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="p" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" limited="true" range="-0.5 0.5" margin="0.1"
             solimplimit="0.9 0.95 0.2 0.5 2"/>
      <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.02" mass="1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>

mixed_solreffriction.xml:
<mujoco model="s31_one_zero">
            <option gravity="0 0 -9.81" timestep="0.002" solver="Newton"
                    cone="elliptic"/>
            <worldbody>
                <geom name="floor" type="plane" size="5 5 0.1"/>
                <body name="ball" pos="0 0 0.1">
                    <joint type="free"/>
                    <geom name="sphere" type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="1.0"/>
                </body>
            </worldbody>
            <contact>
                <pair geom1="floor" geom2="sphere"
                      condim="3" friction="1.0 1.0 0.005 0.001 0.001"
                      solref="0.02 1.0" solreffriction="0.1 0.0"/>
            </contact>
        </mujoco>
